notes: All policies use the same eval seeds for fair paired comparison.
eval_seeds start at 500 and are separate from train_seeds 1000+.
If CI95 intervals overlap, do not claim a reliable winner.

scenario_desc.S1_easy_balanced: Static, near-budget, balanced. Easy control case.
scenario_desc.S2_static_skew: Static, over-budget, strongly skewed to one branch.
scenario_desc.S3_flip_near: Dynamic flip with a one-level optimal move.
scenario_desc.S4_flip_far: Dynamic flip with a far optimal move.
